newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon gives pope surprise birthday party.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon gives pope surprise birthday party.

text.p: Lebanon gave Pope John Paul a surprise birthday party on Saturday complete with birthday cake and a presidential band playing "Happy Birthday to You."

It was eight days before the pope's 77th birthday on May 18, but President Elias Hrawi presented him with a cake in the shape of a yellow-and-white papal flag shortly after he arrived in Beirut on his first visit to Lebanon.

Scores of Lebanese officials and Moslem and Christian clerics crowding round the pontiff in the entrance lobby of the presidential palace applauded as he cut a small slice from a corner of the cake and ate it.
